result.instructions: Tools for RxNorm, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the standard drug code for atorvastatin 20 mg tablets?"; "Which drug class does lisinopril belong to?"; "Can you fix the spelling of 'metphormin' and find the right drug?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RxNorm data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rxnorm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rxnorm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rxnorm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rxnorm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rxnorm_find_rxcui_by_name
tools.title: Find RxCUI by name
tools.description: Find RxNorm concept IDs (RxCUIs) matching a drug name string. RxNav REST: GET /rxcui.

name.description: Drug name to look up, e.g. 'cymbalta'.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_drugs
tools.title: Search drugs by name
tools.description: Search drug products (all term types) matching a name, grouped by concept type. RxNav REST: GET /drugs.

expand.description: Optional expansion, e.g. 'psn' to include prescribable names.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_concept_properties
tools.title: Get concept properties
tools.description: Get the RxNorm properties (name, synonym, tty, language, suppress, umlscui) of a concept. RxNav REST: GET /rxcui/{rxcui}/properties.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_related_by_type
tools.title: Get related concepts by type
tools.description: Get concepts related to a concept, restricted to the specified term types. RxNav REST: GET /rxcui/{rxcui}/related.

tty.description: Space-separated term types, e.g. 'SCD SBD BPCK'.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_all_related
tools.title: Get all related concepts
tools.description: Get every concept directly or indirectly related to a concept (all term types). RxNav REST: GET /rxcui/{rxcui}/allrelated.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_ndcs
tools.title: Get NDCs for a concept
tools.description: Get the NDCs (National Drug Codes) associated with a concept. RxNav REST: GET /rxcui/{rxcui}/ndcs.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_history_status
tools.title: Get concept history / status
tools.description: Get the status, history and attributes of a concept (active, remapped, quantified, etc). RxNav REST: GET /rxcui/{rxcui}/historystatus.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_property
tools.title: Get concept property
tools.description: Get a named property (category, name, value) of a concept, e.g. ATC code or a synonym. RxNav REST: GET /rxcui/{rxcui}/property.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_spelling_suggestions
tools.title: Get spelling suggestions
tools.description: Get spelling suggestions for a possibly-misspelled drug name. RxNav REST: GET /spellingsuggestions.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_approximate_match
tools.title: Approximate term match
tools.description: Fuzzy match a term against RxNorm names — tolerant of abbreviations, misspellings, and extra words. RxNav REST: GET /approximateTerm.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_term_types
tools.title: List term types
tools.description: List all RxNorm term types (metadata), e.g. SCD, SBD, IN, BN. RxNav REST: GET /termtypes.

tools.name: rxnorm_get_drug_classes
tools.title: Get drug classes for a drug
tools.description: Get the drug classes that contain a drug, by drug name (RxClass API). RxNav REST: GET /rxclass/class/byDrugName.

annotations.title: Get drug classes for a drug

tools.name: rxnorm_get_class_members
tools.title: Get drug class members
tools.description: Get the drugs belonging to a drug class (RxClass API). RxNav REST: GET /rxclass/classMembers.

classId.description: Class id, e.g. 'N02BE' (ATC) or a MED-RT class id.

ttys.description: Space-separated term types to include, e.g. 'IN MIN'.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with RxNorm
prompts.description: What you can do with RxNorm here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_standard_code_for_a_drug
prompts.title: Find the standard code for a drug
prompts.description: The AI searches a drug name and returns matching RxNorm concept ids (RxCUIs) and drug products grouped by concept type. You get the right code for a name and strength.

prompts.name: fix_a_misspelled_drug_name
prompts.title: Fix a misspelled drug name
prompts.description: The AI gets spelling suggestions and fuzzy matches for a term with typos or abbreviations. It then finds the intended drug.

prompts.name: find_a_drug_s_class_and_the_drugs_in_a_class
prompts.title: Find a drug's class and the drugs in a class
prompts.description: The AI looks up the drug classes that contain a drug by name, and the drugs that belong to a class.

prompts.name: list_the_national_drug_codes_of_a_product
prompts.title: List the national drug codes of a product
prompts.description: The AI gets the NDCs linked to a drug concept, for example for one tablet or capsule strength.

prompts.name: explore_related_concepts_and_check_status_and_history
prompts.title: Explore related concepts and check status and history
prompts.description: The AI gets the concepts related to a drug by term type, such as ingredient or brand name, or all related concepts. It also reads a concept's status and history.
